summary: Phase 7c backend testing completed. Verified dual-write architecture, module functions, auth gating, shadow-write fallback logic, and source field in responses. All core functionality working as expected. Supabase authentication unavailable (expected per review request), so authenticated endpoint testing done via code inspection and module-level verification.

notes: Supabase authentication is rate-limited/unreliable (expected per review request)
All shadow-write failures are intentionally silent (best-effort design)
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY not configured (expected - user JWT used for writes)
Frontend testing skipped per review request (backend only)
